A wall of albums I keep coming back to. Click any cover to open it on Tidal.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
#| column: screen-inset

library(yaml)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

data <- yaml::read_yaml("albums.yml")

dir.create("images/albums", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

slugify <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(x)
  x <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", x)
  x <- gsub("^-|-$", "", x)
  x
}

fetch_cover <- function(artist, title, slug, override = NULL) {
  dest <- file.path("images", "albums", paste0(slug, ".jpg"))
  if (file.exists(dest)) return(dest)

  src <- override
  if (is.null(src) || !nzchar(src)) {
    q <- utils::URLencode(paste(artist, title), reserved = TRUE)
    url <- sprintf("https://itunes.apple.com/search?term=%s&entity=album&limit=1", q)
    res <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(url), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(res) && res$resultCount > 0) {
      art <- res$results$artworkUrl100[1]
      src <- sub("100x100bb", "600x600bb", art)
    }
  }

  if (is.null(src) || !nzchar(src)) return(NA_character_)

  ok <- tryCatch({
    utils::download.file(src, dest, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) FALSE, warning = function(w) FALSE)

  if (ok) dest else NA_character_
}

fetch_rss_feed <- function(genre = NULL, limit = 100) {
  url <- if (is.null(genre)) {
    sprintf("https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/topalbums/limit=%d/json", limit)
  } else {
    sprintf("https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/topalbums/limit=%d/genre=%d/json", limit, genre)
  }
  res <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(url, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(res)) return(list())
  entries <- res$feed$entry
  if (is.null(entries)) return(list())
  lapply(entries, function(e) {
    imgs <- e[["im:image"]]
    img_url <- imgs[[length(imgs)]]$label
    img_url <- sub("170x170bb", "600x600bb", img_url)
    link <- e$link
    href <- if (is.list(link) && !is.null(link$attributes$href)) {
      link$attributes$href
    } else if (is.list(link) && length(link) > 0 && !is.null(link[[1]]$attributes$href)) {
      link[[1]]$attributes$href
    } else {
      "#"
    }
    list(cover_url = img_url, href = href, id = e$id$label %||% img_url)
  })
}

mockup_pool <- function(n) {
  genres <- list(NULL, 21, 18, 20, 14, 7)  # all, rock, hip-hop, alt, pop, electronic
  pool <- list()
  for (g in genres) {
    pool <- c(pool, fetch_rss_feed(g, 100))
    if (length(pool) >= n * 2) break
  }
  ids <- vapply(pool, function(x) x$id %||% "", character(1))
  pool <- pool[!duplicated(ids)]
  if (length(pool) > n) pool <- pool[sample.int(length(pool), n)]
  pool
}

playlist_url <- data$playlist_url %||% ""
playlist_label <- data$playlist_label %||% "Open shuffle playlist on Tidal"
if (nzchar(playlist_url)) {
  cat(sprintf(
    '<a class="tidal-cta" href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>\n\n',
    playlist_url, playlist_label
  ))
}

mockup_n <- data$mockup_count %||% 0

if (mockup_n > 0) {
  pool <- mockup_pool(mockup_n)
  pool <- pool[sample.int(length(pool))]
  tiles <- vapply(pool, function(a) {
    sprintf(
      '<a class="album-tile" href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img class="album-cover" src="%s" alt="" loading="lazy"></a>',
      a$href, a$cover_url
    )
  }, character(1))
} else {
  albums <- data$albums
  albums <- albums[sample.int(length(albums))]
  tiles <- vapply(albums, function(a) {
    slug <- slugify(paste(a$artist, a$title))
    cover <- fetch_cover(a$artist, a$title, slug, a$cover_url)
    img_src <- if (is.na(cover)) "images/albums/_placeholder.svg" else cover
    href <- a$tidal_url %||% sprintf("https://tidal.com/search?q=%s",
                                     utils::URLencode(paste(a$artist, a$title), reserved = TRUE))
    sprintf(
      '<a class="album-tile" href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="%s — %s"><img class="album-cover" src="%s" alt="%s — %s" loading="lazy"></a>',
      href, a$artist, a$title, img_src, a$artist, a$title
    )
  }, character(1))
}

cat('<div class="album-grid">', paste(tiles, collapse = ""), '</div>', sep = "")
```
